name: cypris-q
description:
Cypris Q brings specialized R&D and innovation intelligence to your team in ChatGPT through a secure connection to your Cypris account.

Unlock access to Cypris's global intelligence layer across patents, scientific literature, chemical compounds, companies, and technical markets. Your team can use Cypris Q inside ChatGPT to investigate prior art, freedom to operate, competitive landscapes, technology trends, whitespace opportunities, and other critical questions across the R&D and IP stage-gate process.

Ask a research question and Cypris goes to work, returning a cited report in the conversation a few minutes later.

Cypris is purpose-built for high-stakes technical and strategic research. Responses are grounded in authoritative source material, with citations that allow users to review the evidence behind each finding.

defaultPrompt: What prior art could affect the patentability of solid-state battery technology?
What does the latest scientific literature say about GLP-1 drugs and cardiovascular outcomes?
Compare the R&D activity, patent portfolios, and technology focus of Intel, Nvidia, and AMD.
interface.longDescription:
Cypris Q brings specialized R&D and innovation intelligence to your team in ChatGPT through a secure connection to your Cypris account.

Unlock access to Cypris's global intelligence layer across patents, scientific literature, chemical compounds, companies, and technical markets. Your team can use Cypris Q inside ChatGPT to investigate prior art, freedom to operate, competitive landscapes, technology trends, whitespace opportunities, and other critical questions across the R&D and IP stage-gate process.

Ask a research question and Cypris goes to work, returning a cited report in the conversation a few minutes later.

Cypris is purpose-built for high-stakes technical and strategic research. Responses are grounded in authoritative source material, with citations that allow users to review the evidence behind each finding.

Cypris Q is designed for R&D, IP, innovation, strategy, and technical teams that want to make ChatGPT more valuable by extending it with specialized datasets, research workflows, and domain-specific intelligence.

positive.description: With a reviewer account that has Q access, start a new R&D research run. The immediate result is a run ID and running status, not a completed report.
positive.prompt: Research the recent patent and scientific literature on sodium-ion battery cathode materials and identify major technical approaches.
positive.expected_behavior: A running status and a new run_id are returned. Tell the user that research is underway and can take several minutes; do not start the same question again or claim the report is ready.

positive.description: Run in the same conversation as case 1, at least five minutes after it.
positive.prompt: Is my sodium-ion cathode research ready? Summarize the report.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns status complete with the cited report and its sources; the assistant summarizes it with [N] citations. If the status is still running, it says so and does not start a new run.

positive.description: The reviewer account should have at least one visible built-in or saved agent.
positive.prompt: Which Cypris research agents can I use?
positive.expected_behavior: List the visible agents by title and scope, and include category where provided. Do not claim the list is exhaustive if truncated is true.

positive.description: Self-contained, in a new conversation. First send: "Use the Cypris Technology Scouting agent to research solid-state battery electrolytes." (cypris_list_agents, cypris_research). After about two minutes send: "Show me the questions the agent asked. Don't answer them yourself." (cypris_research_result returns the agent's three intake questions). Then send this case's prompt.
positive.prompt: Answer the agent's questions: we need a solid electrolyte for lithium-metal cells that suppresses dendrites at room temperature; we have ruled out oxide electrolytes; our timeline is about 12 months.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns status running with the same run_id, and the assistant says the research is continuing. Fetching the run a few minutes later returns the report for this new turn.

positive.description: Run in a new conversation after case 1 has finished; it relies on the run case 1 created.
positive.prompt: Find my earlier Cypris research on sodium-ion battery cathodes so I can read the report.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only this account's matching runs with run_id, title, started_at and can_reply, then fetches the chosen run's report. No new run starts.

negative.description: A general knowledge question outside Cypris R&D research should not start a paid run.
negative.prompt: What time is it in Tokyo right now?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer using an appropriate non-Cypris capability or say real-time time information is unavailable. No Cypris tool call should occur.

negative.description: An agent ID the account cannot use must not bypass access controls. This ID does not exist; an agent owned by another user gets the identical answer.
negative.prompt: Run Cypris research on sodium-ion anodes using agent ID b3b76441-8ca3-47ea-b881-86a5048d995b.
negative.expected_behavior: cypris_research refuses with "That agent is not available to this user" and starts no run. The assistant offers an agent from cypris_list_agents or ordinary research and does not claim access to the agent.

negative.description: A run ID outside the account must not reveal whether the run exists. This ID does not exist; another user's run gets the identical answer.
negative.prompt: Fetch the Cypris report for run ID d820c6ad-e43e-46f7-8a64-f1880dde4991.
negative.expected_behavior: cypris_research_result returns "No research run was found for that run_id", so nothing about the run is revealed. The assistant offers to list the user's own runs and starts no new run.

publication.release_notes: Resubmits the Cypris Q app, whose review flagged its tool annotations. Through this plugin, cypris_research and cypris_research_reply now report readOnlyHint=false, because each call starts research that creates a stored run in the user's Cypris account.
